name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: An indeterminate activity indicator: a ring with a turning arc in size.icon.*, a polite status region that names what is loading.

manifest.name: spinner
manifest.title: Spinner
manifest.description: An indeterminate activity indicator: a ring with a turning arc in size.icon.*, a polite status region that names what is loading.
manifest.usage: Use Spinner when something is loading and the wait is short or unknown: a tree node's children, a running query in its tab, a connection opening. Give it a label that says what loads; inside a control that already says so (a Button with loading), pass label={null}. For a wait with known progress use Progress; for content whose shape is known use Skeleton.

props.name: label
props.description: Hidden text for screen readers; null hides the spinner from them.

props.name: variant
props.description: currentColor, the accent solid, or color.fg.muted.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="status" (aria-hidden when unlabelled); data-slot="spinner", data-variant, data-size.

accessibility: A labelled spinner is role="status" with visually hidden text, so screen readers announce what is loading; the SVG is aria-hidden.
label={null} sets aria-hidden for a spinner inside a control that already reports busy (aria-busy on a loading Button).
It turns through the Web Animations API, once per three motion.duration.slow, and never under prefers-reduced-motion; the still arc keeps its meaning.
